## Services
- B2B lead generation: Lead campaigns, landing forms and follow-up flows that bring in qualified business buyers and hand clean leads to sales.
- Google Ads & search engine marketing: Search and display campaigns, keyword research, bidding and budget pacing tied to cost per lead.
- Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram): Audience targeting, creative testing, retargeting and lead-form campaigns that scale without raising cost per lead.
- Search engine optimisation: Keyword research, on-page SEO and content that grows organic traffic you don’t pay for.
- Social media management: Content calendars, community management and monthly reporting across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube.
- Email & WhatsApp marketing: Nurture sequences, broadcasts and WhatsApp Business follow-ups that turn enquiries into customers.
- Content strategy: Messaging and formats matched to each stage of the funnel, from first impression to the sales call.
- Analytics & reporting: Tracking and reporting on CTR, CPC, CPL, ROAS and lead-to-sale ratio, with clear recommendations.
- Ad creative design: Static and social ad creatives designed in-house in Photoshop, Illustrator and Canva.

## FAQ
### Who is Muhammad Awais Rustam?
Muhammad Awais Rustam is a digital marketing specialist in Doha, Qatar, with over seven years of experience in B2B lead generation, Meta and Google Ads, SEO and social media marketing. He leads digital marketing for Target Group and also takes freelance projects.

### What digital marketing services do you offer?
B2B lead generation, Google Ads and search engine marketing (SEM), Meta Ads on Facebook and Instagram, SEO, social media management, content strategy, email and WhatsApp marketing, analytics and reporting, and ad creative design.

### How do you generate B2B leads?
I combine targeted Meta and Google lead campaigns with clear offers and fast WhatsApp and email follow-up, then qualify each lead before passing it to sales. At Target Group this produces more than 200 qualified B2B leads a month.

### How large a budget can you manage?
I have managed ad budgets of QAR 60,000 per month, split across Meta Ads and Google Ads, planned from lead targets and cost-per-lead goals.

### Which tools and platforms do you use?
Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, SEMrush, Ahrefs and YouTube Studio for marketing, and Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and Canva for creative.

### Do you work with clients outside Qatar?
Yes. Alongside my role in Doha I work on freelance projects for brands in other countries, fully remote.

### Do you also design the ad creatives?
Yes. I design social media posts, ad creatives, flyers and brand assets myself. You can see examples on my design portfolio page.

### How can I hire you?
